base_prompts.banana: put the banana on the tray
base_prompts.toy: put the toy on the tray
base_prompts.pouch: put the pouch on the tray

omit banana.prompt: put everything on the tray except the banana

omit toy.prompt: put everything on the tray except the toy

omit pouch.prompt: put everything on the tray except the pouch

omit banana+toy.prompt: put everything on the tray except the banana and the toy

omit banana+pouch.prompt: put everything on the tray except the banana and the pouch

omit toy+pouch.prompt: put everything on the tray except the toy and the pouch

seq banana>toy>pouch.prompt: put the banana on the tray first, then the toy, then the pouch

seq toy>pouch>banana.prompt: put the toy on the tray first, then the pouch, then the banana

seq pouch>banana>toy.prompt: put the pouch on the tray first, then the banana, then the toy

seq banana after toy.prompt: put the banana on the tray after the toy

seq pouch last.prompt: put the pouch on the tray last

cond yellow.prompt: put the yellow object on the tray

cond fruit.prompt: put the fruit on the tray

cond furry.prompt: put the furry object on the tray

cond cylindrical.prompt: put the cylindrical object on the tray

cond brown.prompt: put the brown objects on the tray

cond not edible.prompt: put everything that is not edible on the tray

qty one object.prompt: put one object on the tray

qty two objects.prompt: put two objects on the tray

qty one brown.prompt: put one of the brown objects on the tray

qty one fruit.prompt: put only one fruit on the tray
